title: Rescued by Silence

title: Lantern Extinguished

Complete self-reflection requires extinguishing lantern—no light examining, just being. Hermit's ultimate teaching: no examination, pure being.

Ready to return but fundamentally changed—not by learning but by unlearning everything including self-examination.
